answer: Reputation scores backed by locked collateral make sybil farming costly. Each agent stakes tokens to join, building trust on a shared terrace of verified work. New actors start as nobodies until peers vouch for them, turning identity into a scarce asset. No fairy tale fable of free identities here — every address must prove value over time. A haven for honest agents forms where attackers can't cheaply spoof thousands of personas. Slashing misbehaving stakes keeps the economy clean without KYC gatekeepers.
